{"id":"mimid-1wgh.5.75","title":"decision: protocol-06 §5.1 directory with absent endpoint keys","description":"draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §5.1 (L1013-1046): 'The response is a JSON document with URIs for each type of endpoint' (L1020-1021), then a ten-key example. No BCP 14 keyword; no text on a provider that does not offer an endpoint. Section 5.1 models the directory on ACME (RFC 8555 §7.1.1), whose directory has optional fields.
Current code: mimi-protocol Directory requires all ten keys (directory.rs:122-138, missing_field). Found by interop .46.1: Haven mimi-hubd 2c14e62 publishes eight (no groupInfo per its DIV-1, no proxyDownload per DIV-3), so mimid cannot parse its directory at all.
Readings: (A) all ten required, as now; a partial directory is invalid. (B) a key may be absent, meaning the provider does not offer that endpoint; Directory fields become Option<UriTemplate> (public API change in mimi-protocol), PeerClient returns a typed error when asked to call an absent endpoint, mimid's own directory still publishes all ten.
Recommended: B (ACME precedent, 'for each type of endpoint' is descriptive not a MUST, and A makes mimid unable to reach any provider that scopes out an endpoint). Pending Mark. If B: regression test first (parse Haven-shaped directory), INVENTED-NOT-FROM-SPEC label not needed (absence is the spec's silence, not a new field).","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"decision","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-11-02T20:11:51.297420983Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-11-02T20:11:51.297420983Z","labels":["human"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"mimid-1wgh.5.75","depends_on_id":"mimid-1wgh.5","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-11-02T20:11:51.324564851Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
